title: Apply the code-driven loop principle across all AI systems
description: No 'loop' hit in the worktree's CLAUDE.md or public/framework/doc/rules.md. public/framework/ai/doc/undone-asks-2026-10-17.md:21 says it was a law at the bottom of CLAUDE.md, so the law is missing here.

priority.why: 9 days old; older asks rank lower

wait.what: Proposed from an old ask (the sort pass over the undone asks): approve, improve or reject

approve.note: serves priority 2: Every ask becomes a task that finishes. The owner, 2026-10-23: don't wait for approval; accept what serves a top priority

priority.why: serves priority 2: Every ask becomes a task that finishes

complete.outcome: Already in force: CLAUDE.md law 7 (Compute, don't recall: record-keeping is code, AI handles judgment) and the node-driven loops that carry it: Servex TaskLoop chases quiet tasks, Server/Steps.mjs is the node-led checklist for landing.
complete.evidence: CLAUDE.md law 7; Servex/doc/task-loop.md; Servex/doc/steps.md; public/framework/ai/doc/tasks.md line 47 links both. The old note that the law was 'at the bottom of CLAUDE.md' is stale: it was folded into law 7 in the 2026-10-22 split.
complete.caveats: I did not audit every AI system for a hand-run loop that should be code; that audit is the open part and is a separate sweep. CLAUDE.md was not edited (needs the owner).
